general.name: General
general.tokens_notice: Colors, fonts and spacing are not editable here by design. They live in design/tokens/tokens.json in the theme repository.
general.logo_info: Placeholder until the brand assets are approved.

price.name: Prices and legal notes
price.tax_mode_info: Shown next to prices on product pages and in the cart.
price.shipping_page_info: Fallback for the 'plus shipping' link if no shipping policy is set in Settings → Policies.
price.show_notes_in_cart: Show tax and shipping notes in the cart
price.compare_label_info: For price reductions in Germany the compare-at price must be the lowest price of the last 30 days. Shopify does not check this.
price.compare_label_lowest_30d: Lowest price in the last 30 days
price.show_unit_price_info: Shows the unit price (e.g. per 100 ml) when the variant has a unit price measurement. Required in Germany for goods sold by quantity.

settings.info: Shows all base components. Development only, removed before launch.

settings.text_info: Leave empty for the default text (next drop date). No prices or discounts.

settings.menu_info: Assumption phase B: Drop 1, About, Contact. Maintain entries in Admin under Content → Menus. Only the first level is shown.

settings.tone_info: Points to a token scope in tokens.json, not a free color choice.
settings.menu_info: Menu with legal notice, privacy, terms and withdrawal, in this order. Maintain it in Admin under Content → Menus (default: menu "footer"). Every entry is shown as a link, even if the policy is still empty. Fill all policies before launch.
